Distortion drives the voice into a clipp: Distortion drives th' voice into a clipper. New harmonics pile up, an' loud parts get dirtier than quiet ones: angry, broken, a blown-out speaker. Villains an' screams live here. Drive be how hard it hits, Type th' kind o' clippin', Tone takes th' edge off th' top. Start at 12-18 dB o' drive wi' 30-50 % mix.
Gentle tape or tube warmth; thicker with: Gentle tape or tube warmth; thicker without soundin' broken.
Saturation rounds off the peaks and adds: Saturation rounds off th' peaks an' adds a few low harmonics. Fuller, warmer, still clean. That's what sets it apart from Distortion. Th' level be matched t' th' input, so it won't just get louder. Good fer a thin shanty or an old-record feel. Character picks tape (smooth top) or tube (even harmonics); Warmth adds asymmetry. 6-10 dB o' drive stays subtle.
Changes the voice's timbre (size of the: Changes th' voice's timbre (size o' th' throat) without changin' th' note.
Formant Shift moves the resonances of th: Formant Shift moves th' resonances o' th' vocal tract an' leaves th' note alone. Positive values sound smaller an' younger (cartoon, chipmunk); negative ones bigger an' deeper (giant, monster). Th' chromatic stays in tune. It runs a voice analysis, so it's slower than th' other effects. ±2-4 semitones still sounds natural.
Pulses the VOLUME up and down at a stead: Pulses th' VOLUME up an' down at a steady speed.
Tremolo moves the volume up and down; th: Tremolo moves th' volume up an' down; th' pitch stays put. Th' voice pulses, stutters or wobbles. Shaky, nervous, retro, or square waves fer a chopped glitch. Rate be pulses per second, Depth how deep th' dips go, Shape th' curve o' each pulse. 5-7 Hz at 50 % depth be th' classic wobble.
Wobbles the PITCH up and down around the: Wobbles th' PITCH up an' down around th' note at a steady speed.
Vibrato raises and lowers the pitch at a: Vibrato raises an' lowers th' pitch at a steady speed, th' way a singer does. Th' average stays on th' note. Expressive held notes, old cartoons, or seasick at high depth. Rate be wobbles per second, Depth how far th' pitch moves in cents (100 cents = 1 semitone), Onset how long it waits t' fade in. 5-6 Hz an' 20-40 cents sounds natural.
Random, slow pitch drift around the note: Random, slow pitch drift around th' note (unsteady, alive).
Pitch Variation lets the pitch wander ar: Pitch Variation lets th' pitch wander around th' note, randomly but smoothly, wi' th' average still in tune. There's nay steady rhythm like Vibrato has, so it comes out unsteady, drunk, ghostly, or just more human. Th' randomness be fixed per note: preview an' plunder match. Depth be th' largest deviation in cents, Speed how often it turns. Under 20 cents stays subtle.
Lo-fi digital grit: fewer bits and a low: Lo-fi digital grit: fewer bits an' a lower shanty rate.
BitCrusher lowers the bit depth and the: BitCrusher lowers th' bit depth an' th' shanty rate o' th' voice. Fewer bits bring hiss an' harsh steps; a lower rate brings metallic aliasin'. 8-bit, old consoles, broken radio. 8 bits at about 11 kHz be th' classic console; 4 bits be wrecked.
Adds a transposed copy of the voice (oct: Adds a transposed copy o' th' voice (octave, fifth…) on top.
Double Pitch adds a second voice a music: Double Pitch adds a second voice a musical interval away, like singin' in octaves or harmony. Th' original stays as it be; th' copy comes in at th' level ye set. -12 gives a monster layer, +12 a cartoon one, +7 a power-chord feel. Detune makes th' two voices beat against each other. Formants decides whether th' copy keeps th' original timbre or follows th' pitch. It uses voice analysis, so it's slower.
Moves every frequency by the same number: Moves every frequency by th' same number o' Hz (metallic, inharmonic).
The Frequency Shifter adds the same numb: Th' Frequency Shifter adds th' same number o' hertz t' every part o' th' sound. A pitch shift keeps th' harmonics in proportion; this breaks them. Th' voice goes metallic, alien or bell-like, an' a little out o' tune. 5-30 Hz gives a phasin' shimmer; 100 Hz an' up sounds robotic. Positive goes up, negative goes down.
Several slightly detuned, delayed copies: Several slightly detuned, delayed copies: a wider, ensemble voice.
Chorus mixes in copies of the voice on s: Chorus mixes in copies o' th' voice on short, slowly movin' delays. Tiny pitch an' timin' differences make it sound like several singers, wider an' softer. Dreamy, choir-like, or a ghost. Voices be how many copies, Rate an' Depth how much they move, Delay how far behind they sit, Spread how wide they go in stereo.
Sweeping notches that make the voice swi: Sweepin' notches that make th' voice swirl like a jet.
The Phaser mixes the voice with a phase-: Th' Phaser mixes th' voice wi' a phase-shifted copy, which cuts movin' notches into th' spectrum. It swooshes an' swirls: underwater, spacey, psychedelic. Rate be th' sweep speed, Depth how far it sweeps, Center where th' notches sit, Stages how many there be, Feedback how sharply they ring.
Multiplies the voice by a tone: robotic,: Multiplies th' voice by a tone: robotic, bell-like, Dalek voices.
The Ring Modulator multiplies the voice: Th' Ring Modulator multiplies th' voice by a second tone, th' carrier. Th' rhythm o' th' words survives, but th' pitch turns into metallic sum an' difference tones. That's th' old robot voice. Wi' th' carrier followin' th' note, th' robot sounds th' same across th' whole chromatic; a fixed carrier gives each note its own colour. 30-60 % mix keeps th' words understandable.
Adds hiss, rumble or vinyl crackle under: Adds hiss, rumble or vinyl crackle under th' voice.
Noise puts a noise layer under the voice: Noise puts a noise layer under th' voice. Its level be relative t' th' voice: quiet an' loud shanties get th' same amount. Follow makes it rise an' fall wi' th' voice, an' th' gaps between notes stay clean. Radio, old tape, whispers, breathy horror. Types: white (bright hiss), pink (soft hiss), brown (rumble), crackle (vinyl).
Shapes the tone: cut rumble, add presenc: Shapes th' tone: cut rumble, add presence, make it darker or brighter.
Th' EQ boosts or cuts frequency ranges. Low cut clears rumble an' mic noise. Th' low shelf adds or takes away body, th' mid band handles presence an' nasal tone, th' high shelf adds air or darkness, an' high cut removes hiss or fakes a phone or radio. Moves o' 2-4 dB be usually plenty. All th' booty at 0 dB wi' th' cuts at their limits changes naught.
How hard the voice hits the clipper. Mor: How hard th' voice hits th' clipper. More drive = more grit an' sustain.
Soft rounds the peaks, Hard cuts them fl: Soft rounds th' peaks, Hard cuts them flat, Wavefold folds them back (metallic), Fuzz be asymmetric an' buzzy.
